paragraphs.source_zh: 次日一早，石川数正带着濑名姬和孩子离开了骏府。既已交涉完毕，就没有必要再在骏府停留片刻。濑名姬和阿龟坐在轿中，由关口家的家臣负责护卫；石川数正则把竹千代放在自己马上，以防万一。他们出了府邸，天色还有些朦胧，不时可以邂逅昨晚狂舞后的男女睡眼惺忪地往家赶。

paragraphs.source_en: The fragrance of little Takechiyo’s hair drifted into Kazumasa’s nostrils. Kazumasa bit his lips tightly, but tears nevertheless began to stream down his face.

units.source_en: The fragrance of little Takechiyo’s hair drifted into Kazumasa’s nostrils.
units.source_zh: 小竹千代的头发散发出芳香，钻进数正的鼻孔。

units.source_en: Kazumasa bit his lips tightly, but tears nevertheless began to stream down his face.

ja.t: みしめたが、こらえきれず

units.source_zh: 数正紧咬双唇，不禁潸然泪下。

paragraphs.source_en: The day before, after being ordered to write the pledge and affixing his seal in blood, he had immediately left the castle. He had felt as though he were dreaming, as though all the strength in his body had been spent; he staggered to the castle gate and nearly fell several times along the way.

units.source_en: The day before, after being ordered to write the pledge and affixing his seal in blood, he had immediately left the castle.
units.source_zh: 昨天，他奉命写下誓书，按下血印后，便立刻出了城。

units.source_en: He had felt as though he were dreaming, as though all the strength in his body had been spent; he staggered to the castle gate and nearly fell several times along the way.

ja.t: れそうになりながら、よろめいて

units.source_zh: 那时如在梦中，好像已用尽了全身的气力，摇摇晃晃地到了城门，其间几欲摔倒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 昨天，他奉命写下誓书，按下血印后，便立刻出了城。那时如在梦中，好像已用尽了全身的气力，摇摇晃晃地到了城门，其间几欲摔倒。

paragraphs.source_en: He was actually still alive! More importantly, the matter over which Motoyasu had been consumed with anxiety was at last resolved; the scheme upon which he had staked his life had finally succeeded. At the thought that Takechiyo, Princess Sena, and Lady Okame had all been rescued safely, Kazumasa was overcome by waves of dizziness and weakness in his legs.

units.source_en: He was actually still alive!
units.source_zh: 自己居然还活着！

units.source_en: More importantly, the matter over which Motoyasu had been consumed with anxiety was at last resolved;
units.source_zh: 更重要的是，元康一直心急如焚的事终于见分晓；

units.source_en: the scheme upon which he had staked his life had finally succeeded.
units.source_zh: 他以生命做赌注的计策也终于奏效。

units.source_en: At the thought that Takechiyo, Princess Sena, and Lady Okame had all been rescued safely, Kazumasa was overcome by waves of dizziness and weakness in his legs.
units.source_zh: 想到竹千代、濑名姬和阿龟小姐平安得救，数正感到一阵阵眩晕，双腿发软。

paragraphs.source_zh: 自己居然还活着！更重要的是，元康一直心急如焚的事终于见分晓；他以生命做赌注的计策也终于奏效。想到竹千代、濑名姬和阿龟小姐平安得救，数正感到一阵阵眩晕，双腿发软。

paragraphs.source_en: Kazumasa somehow managed to cross the castle moat and leaned against a willow tree, whereupon his tears poured forth; he even feared that he might collapse there and be unable to move. He did not know how he had made his way back to the Shōshō residence.

units.source_en: Kazumasa somehow managed to cross the castle moat and leaned against a willow tree, whereupon his tears poured forth; he even feared that he might collapse there and be unable to move.

けなくなるのではないかとさえ

units.source_zh: 数正好不容易走过护城河，靠在柳树上，泪水顿时倾泻而下，甚至担心自己会倒在此处，不能动弹。

units.source_en: He did not know how he had made his way back to the Shōshō residence.
units.source_zh: 他不知道自己是如何走回少将宫的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正好不容易走过护城河，靠在柳树上，泪水顿时倾泻而下，甚至担心自己会倒在此处，不能动弹。他不知道自己是如何走回少将宫的。

paragraphs.source_en: Princess Sena and her father, Chikanaga, were likewise beside themselves with joy. Early that morning, they had at last been able to leave Sunpu in great haste.

units.source_en: Princess Sena and her father, Chikanaga, were likewise beside themselves with joy.
units.source_zh: 濑名姬和父亲亲永也欣喜若狂。

units.source_en: Early that morning, they had at last been able to leave Sunpu in great haste.

ja.t: つことができたのである。

units.source_zh: 今日一早，他们终于得以匆匆忙忙离开骏府。

paragraphs.source_zh: 濑名姬和父亲亲永也欣喜若狂。今日一早，他们终于得以匆匆忙忙离开骏府。

paragraphs.source_en: Cherry blossoms fluttered down upon master and retainer.

units.source_en: Cherry blossoms fluttered down upon master and retainer.
units.source_zh: 樱花纷纷飘落到主从二人身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 樱花纷纷飘落到主从二人身上。

paragraphs.source_en: After resting for two nights along the way, Kazumasa’s party finally entered the territory of Okazaki. Everything was proceeding according to plan.

units.source_en: After resting for two nights along the way, Kazumasa’s party finally entered the territory of Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 数正一行在途中歇息了两宿，终于进入了冈崎的领地。

units.source_en: Everything was proceeding according to plan.
units.source_zh: 一切都在计划之中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 数正一行在途中歇息了两宿，终于进入了冈崎的领地。一切都在计划之中。

paragraphs.source_en: Acting on Ujizane’s orders, the garrison of Yoshida Castle carefully escorted Kazumasa’s party toward Nishigori Castle. Nishigori Castle was held by Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami and his eldest son. Motoyasu had bestowed Nishigori Castle upon Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami, probably because he had recognized the honesty and generosity of the man who was now his birth mother’s husband.

units.source_en: Acting on Ujizane’s orders, the garrison of Yoshida Castle carefully escorted Kazumasa’s party toward Nishigori Castle.
units.source_zh: 因为得到氏真的命令，吉田城守军小心护卫着数正一行前往西郡城。

units.source_en: Nishigori Castle was held by Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami and his eldest son.
units.source_zh: 驻守西郡城的，是久松佐渡守和他的长子。

units.source_en: Motoyasu had bestowed Nishigori Castle upon Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami, probably because he had recognized the honesty and generosity of the man who was now his birth mother’s husband.

ja.t: いていたからであろう。

units.source_zh: 元康已将西郡城送给了久松佐渡守，大概是他看到亲生母亲现在的丈夫为人诚实厚道的缘故。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因为得到氏真的命令，吉田城守军小心护卫着数正一行前往西郡城。驻守西郡城的，是久松佐渡守和他的长子。元康已将西郡城送给了久松佐渡守，大概是他看到亲生母亲现在的丈夫为人诚实厚道的缘故。

paragraphs.source_en: Sado-no-kami had stationed his eldest son by a concubine, Yajirō Sadakazu, at Agui Castle in their former domain, and his legitimate son Saburōtarō Katsumoto at Nishigori Castle; he himself was preparing to go to Okazaki and take charge of its defense whenever Motoyasu went on campaign. He therefore joined Kazumasa’s party at Nishigori and traveled with them toward Okazaki. The company immediately took on fresh vigor.

units.source_en: Sado-no-kami had stationed his eldest son by a concubine, Yajirō Sadakazu, at Agui Castle in their former domain, and his legitimate son Saburōtarō Katsumoto at Nishigori Castle; he himself was preparing to go to Okazaki and take charge of its defense whenever Motoyasu went on campaign.

ja.t: にあたるつもりでいた。

units.source_zh: 佐渡守令庶出的长子弥九郎定员驻守旧领阿古居城，嫡子三郎太郎胜元驻守西郡城，而他自己则准备前往冈崎，在元康出征时留守以负责防卫。

units.source_en: He therefore joined Kazumasa’s party at Nishigori and traveled with them toward Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 因此，他在西郡加入数正一行，一起前往冈崎。

units.source_en: The company immediately took on fresh vigor.
units.source_zh: 队伍顿时增添了活力。

paragraphs.source_zh: 佐渡守令庶出的长子弥九郎定员驻守旧领阿古居城，嫡子三郎太郎胜元驻守西郡城，而他自己则准备前往冈崎，在元康出征时留守以负责防卫。因此，他在西郡加入数正一行，一起前往冈崎。队伍顿时增添了活力。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet the nearer Princess Sena drew to Okazaki Castle, the more restless and uneasy she became. She had never been to Okazaki Castle. There would be many retainers she did not know, as well as people of the domain who might not look kindly upon her; all of this filled her with deep unease.

units.source_en: Yet the nearer Princess Sena drew to Okazaki Castle, the more restless and uneasy she became.
units.source_zh: 但濑名姬越接近冈崎城，就越显得焦躁不安。

units.source_en: She had never been to Okazaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 她还未到过冈崎城。

units.source_en: There would be many retainers she did not know, as well as people of the domain who might not look kindly upon her; all of this filled her with deep unease.
units.source_zh: 那里有许多她不认识的家臣，还有对她不一定抱有好感的领民，这一切都让她深感不安。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但濑名姬越接近冈崎城，就越显得焦躁不安。她还未到过冈崎城。那里有许多她不认识的家臣，还有对她不一定抱有好感的领民，这一切都让她深感不安。

paragraphs.source_en: At last the party reached the woods of Ōhira, only one ri from Okazaki, where the castle’s warriors and townspeople were already waiting to welcome them.

units.source_en: At last the party reached the woods of Ōhira, only one ri from Okazaki, where the castle’s warriors and townspeople were already waiting to welcome them.
units.source_zh: 一行人终于到了离冈崎只一里之遥的大平树林，城内的武士和百姓已经在此迎候。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一行人终于到了离冈崎只一里之遥的大平树林，城内的武士和百姓已经在此迎候。

paragraphs.source_en: While Motoyasu was a hostage in Sunpu, he had once returned to pay respects at his ancestors’ graves; on that occasion, the retainers who came here to welcome him had been dressed in rags. Today, however, there were not only retainers but monks and nuns, and even great numbers of ordinary people. Their clothes were neat and their faces well filled; they were no longer as they had been—their unyielding resolve had finally carried them through their hardships.

units.source_en: While Motoyasu was a hostage in Sunpu, he had once returned to pay respects at his ancestors’ graves; on that occasion, the retainers who came here to welcome him had been dressed in rags.

ja.t: したことがあった。そのときここへ

units.source_en: Today, however, there were not only retainers but monks and nuns, and even great numbers of ordinary people.
units.source_zh: 可今天，除了家臣们，还有僧侣尼姑，甚至可以看到为数众多的普通百姓。

units.source_en: Their clothes were neat and their faces well filled; they were no longer as they had been—their unyielding resolve had finally carried them through their hardships.
units.source_zh: 他们衣着整洁，面容丰润，已经今非昔比了——坚强的意志终于使得他们熬过了难关。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康在骏府做人质时，曾经回来为祖先扫墓，那时到这里欢迎他的是衣衫褴褛的家臣们。可今天，除了家臣们，还有僧侣尼姑，甚至可以看到为数众多的普通百姓。他们衣着整洁，面容丰润，已经今非昔比了——坚强的意志终于使得他们熬过了难关。

paragraphs.source_en: Hiraiwa’s manner and laughter were so comical that even Takechiyo could not help laughing; he turned his head and looked at Kazumasa.

units.source_en: Hiraiwa’s manner and laughter were so comical that even Takechiyo could not help laughing; he turned his head and looked at Kazumasa.
